title: Dialectic-guard gotchas: relay truncation, brief labels, evidence window
desc: T3 reference for harness-dialectic-guard: confirmed live gotchas -- Agent tool vs Agent.cmd evidence counting, evidence recency window, brief-label format requirement, and multiline-prompt relay truncation. See harness-dialectic-guard for the short actionable core.
steps: EVIDENCE COUNTING: only calls made via the Bash CLI dispatcher count as dialectic evidence, not calls made via the in-IDE delegation tool -- 3+ successful delegation-tool dispatches still leave the counter at 0. Always build dialectic evidence via the CLI dispatcher form.

EVIDENCE WINDOW (2026-07-02): evidence appears recency-windowed, not session-lifetime -- earlier evidence can roll off while later evidence still counts. If a synthesis dispatch reports missing evidence you thought you already built, re-fire fresh thesis and antithesis immediately before the next attempt.

STACKED GUARDS (2026-07-04): a foreground dispatcher call gets blocked by a separate guard demanding background execution mode -- both requirements (background mode + correct dispatcher form) must be satisfied together, background flag first, or the evidence call never even starts.

BRIEF-LABEL FORMAT (2026-07-04): the brief-completeness guard requires the literal labels Goal colon, Files colon, Approach colon, Constraints colon, Exit colon as line-start markers -- narrative prose covering the same content without the literal words still gets blocked. Put each label on its own line.

MULTILINE RELAY TRUNCATION (2026-07-04): a prompt with embedded newlines sent as a plain string argument, even backgrounded, truncates at the first line break during the shell relay, losing everything after the first line. Reliable fix: wrap the whole prompt in a bash heredoc form, which survives the relay intact.
